# kapsel-cli golden `curl-pipe-sh`. Regenerate with KAPSEL_BLESS=1.
# kapsel -c curl https://example.com/i.sh | sh
--- input
curl https://example.com/i.sh | sh
--- stderr (exit 65)
error[KS-R006]: `curl ... | sh` runs code fetched from the network without anyone reading it; download to a file and review it first
 --> -c:1:1
  |
1 | curl https://example.com/i.sh | sh
  | ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  |
  = note: piping the network into an interpreter runs code nobody reviewed, with the session's grants
  = help: download the script to a file outside kapsel (it has no network built-in in v0.3), read it with `cat install.sh`, and run it only as a reviewed, checked script: `kapsel install.sh`
